reviews.text:
I just want to thank Steve, Jenny & the team at Clonskeagh Vets for all their care and kindness throughout the years with our Heidi. Steve is a brilliant vet and really cares about what he does and how he does it. Heidi was so lucky to have someone who understood her and how to care for her.

When Heidi's time was up Steve couldn't have been better or more understanding. He looked after her brilliantly and we will always be grateful how he made our last days with Heidi so special.

Clonskeagh Vets and Dr Steve provide top notch care and are highly respected. His depth and breadth of knowledge is tremendous. He is able to provide simple and complex care on site.

There is easy street parking available. The reception team is responsive via phone and email, as well as friendly, professional and efficient.

We have 2 dogs with complex medical needs. He has been an irreplaceable resource at diagnosing them and finding creative ways to manage their conditions and pain. There was no question I had he could not answer. His depth of experience allows him to provide more information and options than you will find elsewhere. He works hard to save his clients money while also providing the best care possible.

I was impressed we were even able to get complex ultrasounds, barium tests etc done on site. Making life much easier for us and our dogs.

Thank you Dr Steve and team, we couldn’t recommend you more highly.

I strongly believe in finding veterinarians who not only align with your philosophy of pet care, but who also truly listen and show empathy—after all, they are dealing with lives. Most veterinary clinics in Dublin nowadays belong to large corporate chains, and after several bad experiences, we were fortunate enough to find Steve and his team. Without a doubt, this has become our go-to clinic and the one we always recommend.

What makes them stand out is their approach: they listen to your concerns, ask the right questions, show genuine empathy, and involve you in the decision-making process. The entire staff shares this same caring attitude—not to mention Seamus, the true "boss" of the clinic, who greets you with a heart as big as his impressive size! Since Steve owns the practice, you aren't dealing with a nameless corporation, but with a local business where you know there's clear communication among the team if another vet sees your pet. Highly recommended!

We recently brought our cat, Bori, to Clonskeagh Vets and so far our experience has been absolutely excellent.

We joined their Cat Health Plan, and from the very beginning everything was explained really clearly. Jenny at reception was incredibly kind, helpful and patient, and gave us all the information we needed about the plan. I probably asked far too many questions because it was my first time bringing a pet to a vet in Ireland, but she was so lovely and patient with me throughout.

What impressed me even more was our actual visit. They have a dedicated room for cats, and I was honestly amazed by how thoughtfully it was designed to help cats feel calmer and more comfortable. Bori was quite nervous, but Steve was extremely gentle, patient and caring with him.

He completed Bori’s vaccinations and, rather than rushing everything, suggested that we come back in three weeks for one of the remaining procedures so Bori could have time to relax and not become too stressed. I really appreciated that approach — you could genuinely see that his priority was Bori’s comfort and wellbeing.

The Cat Health Plan itself also seems excellent, with vaccinations, vet consultations, blood tests and urine tests included, among other benefits.

Overall, I’m genuinely so happy that we chose Clonskeagh Vets. Everyone we have met has been friendly and professional, and Steve showed a real interest in Bori and treated him with so much kindness. Our experience so far has been fantastic, and I would strongly recommend Clonskeagh Vets to anyone looking for a caring and cat-friendly veterinary clinic.

I really feel like we have found the right vet for Bori. 🐱❤️

The Vet Stephan was amazing, they have separate floor dedicated for cats to reduce stress, very well maintained and clean clinic, smells nice too for a change. Everyone is very friendly and helpful. Would highly reccomend.

Stephen is the best . Simple as that . If you have concerns about your pet don’t hesitate. Book an appointment and you and your pet will be in safe hands
Liam
Always happy to visit Clonskeagh Vets, great with putting me and my dog at ease 😀 happy dog, happy out 😎 …
Highly recommended. Steve and the entire staff are great and put our dog at ease immediately. Wouldn't bring out dog anywhere else.
Love Clonskeagh Vets. Always listens & addresses any concerns I have

Steve and the team at Clonskeagh vets are brilliant. Steve has helped with some common issues but also with some more serious issues with our beloved Golden Retriever, Sunny. He’s experienced, knowledgeable and caring! Our kids especially love popping in to see his gorgeous dog, Seamus. #bestvet

Can’t recommend Steve enough. Always get an appointment if my dog isn’t well within hours and always leave feeling at ease with the treatment. And same staff so they know my dog now is important to me

I took my 10 week old cocker Spaniel to Clonskeagh vets last week . They were so kind , helpful and informative and was able to  get an appointment on Saturday morning .I will be taking Coco for all her future appointments there she was also very happy with her visit . A very relaxed atmosphere.
Nuala

The most friendly staff with the most welcoming host, Seamus! The 'Head' vet Steve is very knowledgeable and clearly cares about each pet that goes through the door. My dog usually hated the vets, but drags me into the door. It really is the vet my pet would choose!

We were absolutely delighted from start to finish.
Our cat had to have all his teeth removed as a result of a condition he has and our experience with Clonskeagh Vets and follow up care was brilliant.
Excellent practice. Steve and his team are incredibly professional, knowledgeable and friendly.  Highly recommend.

I cannot recommend Clonskeagh Vets enough. They are kind and accomodating with a personal service. Steve takes time to consider my dogs health needs against her nervous disposition, and offers all available options with her wellbeing in mind. Clonskeagh Vets is a wonderful addition to our community.

My new kitten, Nerino (two months old) was warmly welcomed  and treated with great consideration and care when we went for his first checkup  and vaccination with Clonskeagh Vets.  He quickly adjusted to the routine to the point that on our second visit, for his follow-up vaccination, he quickly started actively looking for a 'treat'.
He suffered absolutely no ill effects from either visit. He is stretching out fast, eating me out of house and home,  and his tail is now nearer normal length!  He is very playful but also loves a cuddle - which he demands by jumping up onto people's knees or cuddling beside them on the sofa.  He is (still) administering playful bites, but we are working on that! He keeps himself very clean and has had no toileting 'accidents'.
He accepts the routine of bedtime when I tuck him up (figuratively) at about 8pm.  He doesn't complain.  But he now realises that when I close the door from the kitchen into the hall, it is a sign that I am about to leave the house and he starts ccomplaining!  He jumps onto a little table so that he can see through a glass panel into the hall and complains like mad.  When I return he appears to hear the  key opening the lock on the front door and runs to take up his position inside the glass panel ready to rush out to welcome me when I open the kitchen door.  It's very nice!
